title: M0 wire/configuration schemas
description: Design contract only. Shared type shape plus normative semantic validators in contracts.md. Typed response item field schemas come from the normalized field dictionary; this open object is not permission for arbitrary unregistered facts.

snapshot/1.persistence: Paired snapshot record uses the same ID, kind snapshot, BD0.1, independent scope and snapshot_id=self; stores identity-input/1 plus field/evidence metadata.

action_execution/1.derivation_rule: Column names mean exact persisted values. sha256(...) hashes canonical JSON of the named persisted value(s), no LF. Other named primitive discriminators are persisted only in this identity-input and revalidated against the declared source/producer oracle. Never derive them from labels, allocation addresses or completion time.

evidence.locator_reference_rule: record: followed by an exact canonical ID is an outbound reference subject to minimal-anchor closure.

policy_rules.diagnostic_and_coverage_text: Acquisition, compiler diagnostics, unsupported or failure explanations only; never successful optional payload dumps or enumerated omitted structures.

x-worker-fingerprints.physical_path_semantics: Context identity retains path-sensitive semantic values when normalization changes meaning.

x-worker-feature-policy.complete_means: all requested features complete; unrequested features remain explicitly not_attempted

input_stabilization.final_consumed_file_keys: Must exactly equal expected_consumed_file_keys as a set, including main file; all keys must resolve to captured request files.
input_stabilization.discovery_records: Discard all semantic facts; retain only validated consumed-input/discovery/diagnostic evidence for planning the next request.

x-provenance-policy.evidence_blob_policy: Explicit captured input existing before semantic analysis; never analysis-produced AST/CFG/data-flow dump.

compiler_cfg_v1.guarantee_text: Compiler intraprocedural structural transitions for the declared supported body.
assumptions: Only declared supported control-flow constructs are modeled.
Structural transitions do not establish runtime feasibility.

reaching_definitions_v1.guarantee_text: May-reaching definitions of proven local and parameter storage over the accepted CFG.
assumptions: The accepted CFG and ordered adapter storage events define evaluation order.
Unmodeled effects are explicit unknown boundaries.

direct_calls_v1.guarantee_text: Compiler-selected direct call declarations under the declared context.
assumptions: External implementations and indirect dispatch retain unknown boundaries.

root_reachability_v1.guarantee_text: Reachability in the declared relationship graph from the explicit root policy.
assumptions: The root set is not claimed exhaustive without separate evidence.
